jobs.description: For the AS Watson warehouse in Ede, we are looking for order picking/packing employees for the morning shift. You can work part-time or full-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that orders leave the warehouse on time and that the correct quantities for the orders are collected.Your duties consist of:- Collecting orders using voice picking- Checking orders- Neatly and carefully packing orders- Preparing orders for shipment- Ensuring a clean and safe working environmentYou will work the morning shift from 07:00 – 16:00, ideal if you are a morning person or prefer to keep your afternoons free for other things.- You are available for at least 2 days a week- You speak Dutch and/or English- Available to work on Saturdays once every 4 weeks- Do you need a work permit? We are happy to help you with your application- You can work from 07:00 to 16:00
